name: ButtonDropdown
description: Combines a primary button action with an attached menu.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Controls whether the menu is open.

attributes.name: close-on-select
attributes.description: Closes the menu after a selection.

attributes.name: keep-open
attributes.description: Keeps the menu open after selection.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Aligns the menu to the button.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Defines menu items programmatically when declarative noora-dropdown-item children are not used.

slots.name: icon-left
slots.description: An icon before the main label.

slots.name: icon-right
slots.description: An icon after the main label.

events.name: noora-action
events.description: Emitted when the primary button is activated.

events.name: noora-open-change
events.description: Emitted when the menu opens or closes.

events.name: noora-select
events.type: CustomEvent<{ item: Record<string, unknown>; value: unknown }>
events.description: Emitted when a menu item is selected.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Attach related options to a primary action.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Button dropdowns are available in medium and large sizes.
examples.markup:
<noora-button-dropdown label="Button" size="medium">
  <noora-dropdown-item value="1">Option 1</noora-dropdown-item>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="2">Option 2</noora-dropdown-item>
</noora-button-dropdown>
<noora-button-dropdown label="Button" size="large">
  <noora-dropdown-item value="1">Option 1</noora-dropdown-item>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="2">Option 2</noora-dropdown-item>
</noora-button-dropdown>

examples.title: Icons
examples.description: Place icons on either side of the main action label.
examples.markup:
<noora-button-dropdown label="Button">
  <noora-icon slot="icon-left" name="chevron_left"></noora-icon>
  <noora-icon slot="icon-right" name="chevron_right"></noora-icon>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="1">Option 1</noora-dropdown-item>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="2">Option 2</noora-dropdown-item>
</noora-button-dropdown>

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: The disabled state prevents both action and menu interaction.
